items.title: Reconcile Stable/S+/S-/O+ Definitions for V182o Re-Audit
items.description: The live jnwb.addressing is_stable proxy (quality>=1.0, stable_plus aliased identically) is a much weaker test than the project's canonical 3-criterion stability pipeline (tag_stable_units.py: >=5 spikes/trial in every correct trial + firing_rate>=1Hz + (presence_ratio>=0.98 OR snr>0.75)), and the earlier V182o O+ candidate audit (examples/06_find_omission_positive_units_v182o.py) used an ad hoc Mann-Whitney+4Hz-diff test instead of the project's real candidate-labeling pipeline (run_spk_response_metrics_a8_1.py: paired Wilcoxon vs local pre-omission baseline + unpaired Mann-Whitney vs matched control, Cohen's d>0.3, BH-FDR q<0.05, S_plus/S_minus/O_plus_candidate/X_candidate priority resolution). Re-run both the canonical stability test and the canonical S+/S-/O+/X candidate pipeline on sub-V182o_ses-260629 so results are comparable to the historical grand_database_6040_units.csv methodology, and reconcile which of the previously-flagged 4 units survive under the correct definitions.

items.title: Dual-engine (Parametric & Nonparametric) Significance Testing utility
items.description: Implement a unified statistical comparison helper in jnwb/statistics.py that runs both parametric (t-test/ANOVA) and nonparametric (Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitney) tests on multi-trial averaged data (PSTHs, LFP power, correlations) and applies Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across time/frequency bins to control false positives.
items.reframe: FDR must be across hypothesis family (time/freq/units), NOT across parametric+nonparametric pair. Tracked under jnwb/statistics.py.

items.title: Hierarchy-Wide Multi-Band Power Correlation Matrix Heatmaps
items.description: Generate pairwise power correlation heatmaps across the V1-to-PFC hierarchy for four distinct bands (Theta 2-8Hz, Alpha 8-14Hz, Beta 15-30Hz, Gamma 32-80Hz) to compare stimulus vs omission periods, with statistical significance overlays corrected for multiple comparisons.

items.title: LFP Spectral Power Omission Dampening Traces
items.description: Plot hierarchy-wide LFP power traces relative to baseline for visual stimulation, delay, and omission epochs across V1, V2, MT, TEO, V3a, FST, FEF, and PFC, with shaded SEM and corrected statistical significance bands.

items.title: Single-Unit Omission-Ramping vs Stimulus-Driven Profile Classification
items.description: Classify single-neuron spiking patterns into stimulus-excited, stimulus-inhibited, and omission-ramping profiles using Wilcoxon and Mann-Whitney significance criteria relative to pre-stimulus and pre-omission baselines (q < 0.05 FDR corrected).

items.title: Hierarchy-Wide Multi-Unit Activity (MUA) Sequence Response Profile
items.description: Epoch and plot MUA timecourses across V1, V3a, MT, FEF, and PFC over the entire visual stimulation sequence (4 stimulus presentations + delays + omission window) to test if omission selectively spares lower-order sensory MUA while producing weak, time-locked prediction-error spikes in higher-order FEF/PFC, validated with FDR-corrected Wilcoxon and t-tests.

items.title: Gamma-Beta Dissociation and R-Squared Change Matrices
items.description: Calculate the R-squared correlation difference (Stimulus vs Omission window) across visual areas to quantify gamma-beta spectral dissociation, verifying if FEF/PFC show the lowest correlation change across states, backed by bootstrapped confidence intervals and multiple comparison corrections.

items.title: Audit 2026-07-10: Remove synthetic decoding metrics
items.description: jnwb/decoding.py returns fabricated accuracy (0.5+noise) with status=synthetic_fallback when trials < 2. Replace with raise or NaN + explicit insufficient_trials status; never invent quantitative performance. Also soft-fail report.py synthetic accuracy curve if present.

items.title: Audit 2026-07-10: Fix FDR misuse in StatisticalAnalysis
items.description: compare_groups/compare_multiple_groups/correlate apply BH-FDR to the pair (parametric_p, nonparametric_p) â€” statistically meaningless. Remove 2-pvalue FDR; keep dual tests as exploratory dual-report; add experiment-level FDR helpers that correct across hypotheses (units/channels/freqs/time). Reframe existing Dual-engine plan accordingly.

items.title: Audit 2026-07-10: Nested CV + no optimistic decoding bias
items.description: CPU path does GridSearchCV then cross_val_score on same data; GPU path picks best C from same folds used for reported accuracy. Switch to nested CV (outer eval / inner tune) or report grid.best_score_ only with clear 'inner-CV' label; add majority-class baseline (already partially tracked on decoding).

items.title: Audit 2026-07-10: Effect-size naming + CIs on compare_groups
items.description: Document paired Cohen's dz vs independent pooled d; attach bootstrap_ci (already exists as method) to compare_groups primary effect; optional assumption checks (normality/variance) with primary-test recommendation without inventing a single 'the answer'.

items.title: Audit 2026-07-10: Granger diagnostics + regularized VAR
items.description: Add stationarity (ADF/KPSS), residual whiteness (Ljung-Box), residual independence checks before interpreting GC; expose BIC/HQIC alongside AIC; optional ridge/shrinkage VAR for ill-conditioned high-order fits; fix residual variance divisor to N-p explicitly.

items.title: Audit 2026-07-10: Spike-train MI beyond binary occupancy
items.description: spike_mutual_information bins then hist>0 â†’ MI(binary occupancy), not MI(spike trains). Add count-based discrete MI and/or continuous-time estimator; label current API as binary_occupancy_mi.

items.title: Multi-page Markdown analysis reports with embedded SVG figures
items.description: Canonical analysis deliverable format: SVG is the only standard visualization format for this project; HTML (via report.py) is for web-facing viewing only, not the source of truth. Build a jnwb markdown report generator that takes a session's canonical audit output (e.g. outputs/publication_figures/canonical_audit_<session>.csv from the stability/S+/S-/O+/X pipeline in examples/07_canonical_stability_and_response_audit_v182o.py) and renders a multi-page markdown bundle per session: one page per analysis stage (overview, stability, response classification, raster suites, TFR if available), each embedding real matplotlib-generated SVGs via relative image links, plus a top-level index.md table of contents. Prototype against sub-V182o_ses-260629 first so the shape can be reviewed before generalizing to a CLI/batch tool.

items.title: Figure 3: S+/S-/O+ raster grid across R-family conditions
items.description: scripts/build_figure3_raster_grid.py -- 4x3 real raster grid (rows RRRR/RXRR/RRXR/RRRX, columns S+/S-/O+), 40 real trials/panel, black spikes, epoch-colored shading matching the reference sequence-timing template, dual time axis (numeric ms + epoch tag), non-negative-integer trial ticks. Unit picks corrected twice this session (2026-07-13): first from a drift-stability-only method to a real omission/control ratio check (O+ unit 41 -> 51), then all three columns re-selected via real template-correlation (scripts/template_correlation_selection.py) since the drift-only S+/S- picks (units 17, 189) turned out non-significant matches to their claimed response shape. Current picks: S+=337 (r=0.985,p=0.008), S-=261 (r=0.985,p=0.003), O+=51 (r_mean=0.769, best of 7 real O+ candidates, no unit reaches p<0.05 in all 3 omission conditions simultaneously -- real, stated statistical-power limit of the one-hot template, not yet resolved). Verified: python -m pytest tests/ -q -> 172 passed, 0 failed; SVG rendered via svglib->PDF workaround and visually inspected. NOT yet committed/pushed. Handout: context/info/09_figure3_handout_2026-07-13.md.

items.title: Template-correlation unit selection method (S+/S-/O+ exemplar picking)
items.description: scripts/template_correlation_selection.py -- real per-epoch duration-normalized firing rate (Hz), Pearson-correlated against idealized 0/1 pulse templates over the real epoch sequence (fx,p1,d1,p2,d2,p3,d3,p4,d4): S+ template 0-1-0-1-0-1-0-1-0, S- template 1-0-1-0-1-0-1-0-1, O+ one-hot at the real omitted slot per condition. Real permutation-test p-value (5000 draws, shuffled epoch-rate assignment), no Gaussian asymptotics assumed on the 9-sample vector. Scanned 330 real qualifying units in sub-C31o_ses-230823_rec -> outputs/classification/figure3_template_correlation_scan.csv. Open finding, not yet investigated: 3 units labeled 'Other' by the pooled shuffle-test classifier (240, 359, 360) rank in the top-10 S- template matches (r=0.92-0.95, p<0.01) -- possible under-calling by the pooled classifier, worth a dedicated look.

items.title: Run a real Proceed-with-Review pass over the 92-entry progress.json backlog
items.description: 2026-07-13 audit finding: artifacts/developer/review.json has 0 entries while progress.json carries 92 entries self-scored 97-100 during progress work, never independently re-checked. This is the exact mechanism that let suite_06/suite_07 sit fabricated-but-scored-100 for months (see .agents/AGENTS.md footgun #11). Every progress.json score should be treated unverified until a matching review.json row exists citing a real review_command receipt that actually reads the code producing each reported number, not just re-runs it and checks the exit code. Highest-priority PRP action available given current repo state; independent of the schema-shape gap below and does not require resolving it first.

items.title: Reconcile artifacts/developer/{plans,progress,review}.json schema mismatch

Reconciling is real, data-mutating work on a live 92+34-entry backlog -- needs Hamm's explicit go-ahead before any row is renamed, merged, or dropped, per this project's 'no silent edits' discipline.
